meta.defaultTitle: Yavor Community Center - Arts Courses Herzliya
meta.defaultDescription: Yavor Community Center in Herzliya offers a wide variety of arts courses and activities for all ages. Painting, dance, music, ceramics and more. Register today!

hero.title: Yavor Community Center
hero.subtitle: A rich variety of courses and activities for all ages in the heart of Herzliya
hero.description: We offer diverse arts courses, activities for youth, adults, and seniors, and community events. Join us and discover a world of creativity, learning, and friendship.

features.title: Center Activities
features.subtitle: A variety of courses and activities for all ages
features.description: At Yavor Community Center you will find a wide range of courses and activities suitable for all ages and skill levels.

painting.title: Painting & Graphics
painting.description: Painting courses for all levels, from beginners to advanced. Learn different techniques and develop personal creativity.

dance.title: Dance & Movement
dance.description: Diverse dance courses including modern dance, ballet, and folk dances for all ages and skill levels.

music.title: Music
music.description: Music lessons, choirs, and ensembles. Learn to play various instruments and develop musical talent.

ceramics.title: Ceramics & Sculpture
ceramics.description: Creative ceramics and sculpture courses. Work with diverse materials and create unique art pieces.

theater.title: Theater & Acting
theater.description: Theater courses for beginners and advanced students. Develop directing, acting, and presentation skills.

youth.title: Youth Activities
youth.description: Diverse programs for youth including creative activities, social engagement, and community involvement.

seniors.title: Senior Activities
seniors.description: Courses and activities adapted for seniors, including maintaining physical and mental fitness.

events.title: Birthdays & Events
events.description: We host birthdays and special events with unique creative experiences for all guests.

cta.title: Ready to Join?
cta.subtitle: Join our community and discover a world of creativity and learning
cta.description: Register for the course that interests you and start your journey at Yavor Community Center. We are here to answer any question.
